# Vitali Shpakowski — Principal Software Engineer | Agentic AI Engineer

> Personal portfolio and interactive CV of Vitali Shpakowski (Виталий Шпаковский) — Principal Software Engineer, Agentic AI Engineer, and Full-Stack & Mobile Architect with 14+ years of commercial experience across BigTech, Enterprise (FinTech, E-Commerce, Corporate AI), and independent SaaS & Mobile products.

Extensive experience delivering large-scale BigTech and Enterprise systems across FinTech, E-Commerce, and corporate AI, alongside launching independent tech products. Owns Full-Stack architecture and System Design aligned with business requirements (Monorepo, BFF, Micro-frontends, DDD, Hexagonal, Event-Driven), integrating web applications, cross-platform mobile (Flutter for iOS & Android), and backend services into a unified platform.

Provides technical leadership and business-to-engineering alignment: managing development teams, enforcing engineering standards, and scaling delivery workflows with AI agents (Agentic Factories, Harness, Context & Graph Engineering, Spec-Driven Development) to accelerate Time-to-Market while maintaining strict control over architecture and code security.

Key competencies:
- **Agentic AI:** Harness Engineering (Skills, Rules, Hooks, MCP), Agentic Factories, Context & Memory Engineering, Graph Engineering & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Spec-Driven Development (AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, PRD), AI Guardrails, Evals & Code Review, Agentic Runtimes (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI).
- **Architecture:** System Design (Microservices, Micro-Frontends, BFF), Domain-Centric (DDD, Clean, Hexagonal), Event-Driven & CQRS, Monorepo & Feature-Sliced Design (FSD), API Design & Contracts, SOLID / DRY / KISS / YAGNI, Technical Roadmap & ADR, Team Leadership.
- **Frontend:** ECMAScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React & Next.js (SSR/SSG), Angular 18+ (Signals), Zustand & React Query, Module Federation, Tailwind CSS, Web Vitals & Performance, Jest / Vitest / Playwright.
- **Mobile:** Flutter, Dart, iOS & Android, Riverpod, Local-First Architecture, Offline Sync (SQLite), Telegram Mini Apps (TMA SDK), App Store & Google Play Release.
- **Backend:** Node.js, NestJS & Express.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase & Firebase, Prisma ORM, Redis, MongoDB, REST API & WebSockets, OAuth 2.0 / JWT / SSO, OpenSearch & Coveo AI.
- **DevOps:** Docker, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Oracle Cloud, Cloudflare, Firebase, Nginx, Terraform, SonarQube.

Career history:
- **MCP COOP** — Principal Software Engineer | Team Lead (June 2025 — Present): Designed and shipped cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), SaaS web platforms, and AI-powered Telegram Mini Apps & bots; architected project-specific Agentic Factories and AI Harness configurations.
- **Career Break / Sabbatical** — Planned Sabbatical & Strategic Shift to AI (January 2025 — May 2025): Planned recharge after 11 years in Enterprise and rebuilding engineering workflows around AI agents and LLMs.
- **EPAM Systems** — Senior Software Engineer (December 2013 — December 2024): Delivered enterprise platforms for SAP Coveo AI Search Platform, US Bank Loyalty Program, Carrefour, Refinitiv, and MoneySuperMarket.
- **Startup Labs** — Middle Frontend Developer (April 2013 — December 2013).
- **Axamit Versa** — Junior Frontend Developer (April 2012 — March 2013).
